items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1976-02-13
items.q: I never like to hear anybody say, I copied such and such a person. You know. Mm-hmm. I was inspired by him.

ctx.x: A lot of times, if you sit there and analyze it, you'll see that Allman will even rearrange the structure of a piece, or he'll play one strain quite differently, in a different order. I'm trying to say. Yes, that's right.

I do. I don't think that you should try to copy the composer, because then you kind of lose something when you do this, because they can only be the composer. You can't copy him. You know, you can't. I never like to hear anybody say, I copied such and such a person. You know. Mm-hmm. I was inspired by him. Yeah. Something like that, you know. That's true. Mm-hmm.
